name: Diamond Theme
description: Customizable, animated UI themes for Diamond Pack / Diamond Vortex

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Recolor Diamond Pack / Diamond Vortex buttons with the theme shader. The active pack is detected automatically (UHD textures).

geode-buttons.name: Theme Geode Buttons
geode-buttons.description: Also restyle Geode's own buttons (main menu Geode button, round/tab buttons in the mods list) in the same style. No extra textures needed.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: original: same as the pack. original-flow: original colors in motion. vortex: Diamond Vortex style colors. glass: white liquid glass. frosted: classic frosted glass (translucent + strong blur, no liquid effects, like iOS 7-18 or Windows acrylic). invert: see-through buttons whose icons and text invert the background. file: load the Theme File below (changes apply as soon as you save it). custom: use the settings below.

theme-file.name: Theme File
theme-file.description: Theme JSON used when Preset = file. Examples are in the themes folder of this mod's config folder (my-theme.json, vortex.json, ...). The preview tool's Theme JSON can be pasted into a file here.

advanced.name: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Opens the advanced settings window: per-part and per-color-range adjustments, surface and glass details, inverted parts, active button colors and list colors. Reset All (and this item's reset arrow) also resets the advanced settings.

theme-actions.name: Theme Files
theme-actions.description: Save: writes the current look (whatever preset or custom settings are active) to a new file in the themes folder and selects it as the Theme File. Set Preset = file to use it. Folder: opens the themes folder.

gradient-mode.name: Gradient Mode
gradient-mode.description: rainbow: hue sweep (hue/saturation/brightness). colors: Color 1-3. solid: Color 1 only.

flow.name: Flow Speed
flow.description: Shifts the colors along the gradient (turns per second).

flow-scope.name: Flow On Original-Art Packs
flow-scope.description: For packs whose buttons keep their original art (vanilla GD and similar packs): whole-button = the color flow (original-flow preset, Flow Speed) shifts the whole button picture; icons = only the icons flow and the button body keeps its colors (white and gray icons cannot change hue, so they stay as they are). Diamond-style packs are not affected.

spin.name: Spin Speed
spin.description: Rotates the gradient direction around each button (turns per second).

fill-mode.name: Fill
fill-mode.description: Button body color. original: the pack's. custom: Fill Color. gradient: Fill Color to Fill Color 2 along Fill Angle. theme: the outline gradient, darkened (Fill Theme Strength).

fill-angle.name: Fill Angle
fill-angle.description: Direction of the fill gradient (90 = top to bottom, 0 = left to right).

fill-theme-strength.name: Fill Theme Strength
fill-theme-strength.description: Brightness of the outline gradient used as the fill (fill = theme).

accent-color.name: White Parts Color
accent-color.description: Color for parts that are white in the original (white outlines/icons).

glyph-mode.name: Icon Color
glyph-mode.description: auto: like the original style. accent: White Parts Color. original: original colors.

font-big.name: bigFont Color
font-big.description: original: keep. gradient: same gradient as the outline. custom: Font Color. Labels that the game tints (green, gray...) are left alone.

adjust-title.name: Color Adjust (per-part and per-color adjustments: Advanced Settings)

adjust-mode.name: All Hue Mode
adjust-mode.description: shift: rotate the hue by the Hue value. colorize: set every color to the Hue value (0 red, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, -120 blue, -60 magenta), keeping its own saturation and brightness, so white and black stay as they are.

adjust-hue.name: All Hue
adjust-hue.description: Hue rotation (shift) or target hue (colorize) for the whole button, including details the theme can't separate (shading, decorations). Use this for packs whose parts can't be split. In degrees; keeps shading and brightness, unlike picking a new color.

adjust-saturation.name: All Saturation
adjust-saturation.description: Saturation multiplier for the whole button, including details the theme can't separate (shading, decorations). Use this for packs whose parts can't be split (1 = unchanged, 0 = gray).

adjust-brightness.name: All Brightness
adjust-brightness.description: Brightness multiplier for the whole button, including details the theme can't separate (shading, decorations). Use this for packs whose parts can't be split (1 = unchanged).

adjust-hue-speed.name: Hue Animation
adjust-hue-speed.description: Hue animation: the hue of every themed button keeps rotating by this many degrees per second (negative = the other way, 0 = off). Works on every pack, including packs without splits.

press-style.name: Press Animation
press-style.description: gd: game default (grow + bounce). squash: shrink, spring back. pop: grow a little + glow, elastic release. none: no scale animation. invert: the whole pressed button flips to inverted colors. jelly: the button squishes like jelly while held and wobbles back when released (with glass on, the glass wobbles too).

jelly-strength.name: Jelly Strength
jelly-strength.description: For the jelly press animation: how much the button squishes and wobbles.

hover-glow.name: Hover Glow
hover-glow.description: How much a themed button lights up while the mouse is over it (0 = off).

hover-hue.name: Hover Hue
hover-hue.description: While the mouse is over a button, its hue smoothly rotates by this many degrees (0 = off).

idle-effect.name: Idle Effect
idle-effect.description: pulse: buttons softly glow in and out. shimmer: a light band sweeps across each button.

button-opacity.name: Button Opacity
button-opacity.description: Opacity of the whole themed button (including its shadow).

fill-opacity.name: Fill Opacity
fill-opacity.description: Opacity of the button body only. Outline and icon stay solid.

bevel.name: Emboss
bevel.description: Bevel lighting along the button edges (light from the top left).

glass.name: Glass
glass.description: Frosted glass: the button body shows the background behind it (0 = off).

debug-stats.name: Log Performance Stats
debug-stats.description: Every 5 seconds, writes FPS, draw counts and the theme hook cost to the Geode log ([stats] lines). Turn off when not testing.
